I can do that, but I need a few clarifications and your explicit confirmation before I perform any archive actions.

Questions / confirmations
1. Which sender? Do you mean the sender of the message you’re currently viewing, or a specific email address? Please paste the senders’ email address(es) or say “current message sender.”
2. Which account/mailbox should I operate on (work account, personal Gmail, Outlook, etc.)?
3. Exact scope: archive every thread ever from that sender, or only threads in Inbox/unread/in the last X days? (Archiving all threads is irreversible in the sense that messages leave the Inbox view.)
4. Confirm what you mean by “archive”: move to the account’s Archive folder (or apply Archive label in Gmail)? Not delete or move to Trash.
5. Notification: when tomorrow would you like the notification (time and timezone) and how should I notify you — email to this account, push notification, or other? If you want an email, what subject/body would you prefer?
6. Authorization: do you want me to perform the archiving now (I’ll need access to the account or you must authorize the integration), or would you prefer step‑by‑step instructions so you can do it yourself?

State of uncertainty
- I don’t have the sender address, account, or notification time, so I can’t proceed yet.
- I can’t schedule or perform the archive until you confirm scope and grant access or ask for instructions.

What I’ll do after you confirm
- If you give explicit confirmation plus account access/authorization, I will archive the specified threads (not delete), and then send the requested notification tomorrow at the specified time.
- If you prefer instructions, I’ll provide concise step‑by‑step actions for Gmail and Outlook to archive all threads from that sender.

Please reply with the sender (or “current message sender”), which account
